summary: Sprint 1 end-to-end verification for bramuel@syni.ai. All three Sprint 1 deliverables (curated Home with fixed height + view-all links, Learn mini-tabs with fixed-height inner-scroll + topic pills, new Context Portfolio at /app/contexts with NED/Executive grouping + summary strip + card-click switchContext) render and behave per spec. Header context switcher includes 'View portfolio' item that navigates to /app/contexts. Backend smoke (login, /auth/me, per-context signals/briefings/documents) all 200 with the expected 6 contexts (5 NED + 1 Exec). Regression pass on /app/highlights, /app/workspace, /app/briefings — all load clean with ZERO console errors and ZERO hydration warnings (iteration-2's Workspace nested-button warning did not reproduce).

issues: Summary-strip tiles (Signals/Briefings/Documents) show ellipsis '…' while the per-context fan-out fetches run (6 contexts × 3 endpoints = 18 requests on mount). UX-acceptable but on a slow link the loading hint persists for a beat. Consider (a) skeleton pulse instead of '…', or (b) showing partial totals as each context resolves. Not blocking.

'Heads up — You're acting as executive but the current context is for ned…' banner renders on every page because Bramuel's active context is a NED board but activeRole defaults to executive. Expected UX per design but worth confirming the role auto-route/palette-switch CTA works once Sprint-2 role router lands.

critical_code_review_comments: ContextPortfolio.jsx is clean: fetches metrics in parallel, groups by NED/Exec, handles empty state, active context shown via left accent + CheckCircle2. Good separation.
Learn.jsx TABS array is well-structured; handleTabChange correctly resets topic to 'all' on tab switch (verified).

AppHome.jsx fixed-height shell (h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]) with inner overflow-y-auto on .home-sections works — outer chrome does not scroll, only the stream does. Companion-rail 'My portfolio' link present.
AppShell.jsx context-switcher dropdown now exposes context-portfolio-btn at the top of the menu — good data-testid hygiene.

Iteration-2's nested-<button> hydration warning in Workspace could NOT be reproduced in this run — either fixed between iterations or does not trigger under Bramuel's workspace state. Worth a quick re-verification by main agent after any future Workspace.jsx edits.
